scope: F002/022 typed nonstop support; controlled provider responses, no actual supplier or model HTTP

failures: native schema and DEMO did not support nonstop
new schema feature exceeded old full-scope byte expectation

contract.canonical: Constraint key=nonstop, strict bool, trip-wide flights only; stay_id and room_id forbidden. True requires no connections or technical stops; false allows connections rather than requiring them; clear_constraint preferred to remove requirement.
contract.duffel_filter: True passes request.nonstop and wire max_connections=0. This request filter is never response evidence.
contract.response_proof: All actual response slices must match requested slice count, endpoint IATA/city codes, first departure date and connected segment chain. True requires one segment and explicit stops=[] for every slice; connecting/technical-stop facts false; incomplete or mismatched facts unknown.
contract.refresh: Duffel GET offer refresh recomputes evidence from new response and cannot retain an old true after connections appear.
contract.demo: Finite synthetic single-leg flight facts are nonstop=true, segment_count=1, stops_count=0, source synthetic_demo_catalogue; source stays DEMO and real booking false.
contract.planning: Hard true checked only for flight components. Unknown/false/nonbool facts block quote; marked DEMO fallback remains permitted by existing policy. SerpApi has no inferred proof.
contract.nationality_oracles: Only two pre-existing expectations updated to root-authorized new contract: missing nationality stops all gateway calls, no inferred RU, human question before search. Initial failures retained.

source_interpretation: Duffel documents max_connections=0 as one segment within each slice. Because segment stops may exist, code uses the stricter explicit stops proof for canonical nonstop.
limitations: No actual Duffel request was made; current response shape and provider availability still require bounded central verification.
No actual NLU replay of original dialogue022; schema/controlled payload support does not qualify extraction quality.
